Actually there is crime "贷款诈骗罪" (诈骗贷款) under article 196? It is fraud by obtaining loans through false means. So could be "诈骗" as well. In examples, they used "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" for forging documents. For loan fraud they used "诈骗" maybe. In earlier example with loan fraud? Not present. But we can list both: 诈骗;伪造国家机关证件.

Also maybe "非法吸收公众存款"? No.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗;伪造国家机关证件<eoa>
